title: Order approvals
subtitle: Salesperson → Storekeeper → Manager → Salesperson. {{total}} in this view
emptyNone: No orders have been submitted for approval yet.

AWAITING_STOREKEEPER.label: Awaiting storekeeper
AWAITING_STOREKEEPER.hint: The storekeeper must check the stock, then verify the order or send it back.

AWAITING_MANAGER.label: Awaiting manager
AWAITING_MANAGER.hint: The stock is verified. The manager must approve, reject or return the order.

AWAITING_SALESPERSON.label: Approved - awaiting confirmation
AWAITING_SALESPERSON.hint: The order is approved and the stock is issued. The salesperson must confirm the handover.

RETURNED.label: Returned for correction
RETURNED.hint: The order was sent back. The salesperson must correct the draft and submit it again.

COMPLETED.label: Completed
COMPLETED.hint: The salesperson confirmed the handover. This order is closed.

REJECTED.label: Rejected
REJECTED.hint: The manager rejected this order. It is closed.

CANCELLED.label: Cancelled
CANCELLED.hint: This order was cancelled. It is closed.

events.MANAGER_APPROVED: Approved by the manager - stock issued

storekeeperVerify.label: Verify stock
storekeeperVerify.text: Confirm that the stock for every line is available. The order moves on to the manager.
storekeeperVerify.done: Stock verified. The order is now with the manager.

storekeeperReturn.label: Return to salesperson
storekeeperReturn.text: Use this when stock is missing or the order is wrong. The salesperson gets it back as a draft to correct.

managerApprove.label: Approve
managerApprove.text: Approving issues the stock for every line. The salesperson is then asked to confirm the handover.

managerReject.label: Reject
managerReject.text: Rejecting is final. The order is closed and cannot be submitted again.

managerReturn.label: Return for correction
managerReturn.text: The salesperson gets the order back as a draft, corrects it and submits it again from the start.

acknowledge.label: Confirm handover
acknowledge.text: Confirm that the approved goods were handed over. This closes the order.

dialog.reasonMin: A reason of at least 3 characters is required.

resubmit.confirm: Submit {{orderNo}} for approval again? It goes back to the storekeeper.
resubmit.done: Order submitted again. It is now with the storekeeper.
